verdict.rationale: Gmail ships a documented public RESTful API covering messages, threads, labels, drafts, sending, filters and push-notification watches. Independent developers report building on it (Streak's snoozing, replacing hacky IMAP code with a couple of HTTP calls). The main caveats are coarse OAuth scopes and costly security assessments for restricted-scope apps. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404), and lighter-weight fine-grained access for agent apps without heavy review.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
